detail.title: Synthesis of Question Abandonment and Epistemic Commitments
detail.summary: This proposal develops a fully supported research notebook for project proj-question-abandonment-001 using collected evidence excerpts, addressing the requirement for source-grounded findings on when an intelligent system should abandon its starting question.

detail.title: Criteria for Question Abandonment
detail.question: Under what circumstances should an intelligent system abandon its starting question in favor of more fertile inquiries?
detail.reason: Project has completed its initial synthesis notebook.

detail.title: Epistemic Frameworks for Question Abandonment
detail.summary: This notebook examines the conditions under which intellectual frameworks and starting questions become unchallengeable or require abandonment in favor of more fertile inquiries.
detail.reason: Synthesizing collected evidence to establish a formal notebook for the synthesis-ready project proj-question-abandonment-001.
